Fixed 4 collection errors (ModuleNotFoundError: 'careeros') by prepending /app/backend to sys.path in the test module (test cwd is /app, not /app/backend). Verified: (admin) GET /admin/credits -> 401 without password, 200 with X-Admin-Password returns {openrouter{configured:false},anthropic,links{openrouter:'https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits',anthropic:'https://console.anthropic.com/settings/billing'},alert{email,threshold},email_ready}; PUT /admin/alert-settings 422 on bad email + 422 on threshold<min, 200 persisting {delivered@resend.dev,20} re-read via GET; POST /admin/alert-test returns 200 with sent:false + reason mentioning 'OpenRouter' (no key in preview); GET /admin/llm-health 401 without password, 200 with password returning 'providers' map. Frontend /careeros/radar renders: stat 'Analysées aujourd'hui (règles · IA): 50 · 1/25' (shows rules counter and AI/deep usage over deep_limit=25), 'Pré-analyse chaque offre par règles (sans IA), fait confirmer par l'IA les 5 meilleures du jour, et classe les offres par IPS Radar (provisoire, …). L'IPS officiel est recalculé dans le pack complet…', each offer card has radar-method-{id} badge + radar-deep-btn-{id} 'Analyse approfondie' CTA, radar-source-status shows jooble/workday/boards/adzuna (jooble/adzuna=Non configuré amber), 'Total : 0 offres analysées sur 95 trouvées' (daily cap hit as expected). All 398 data-testids rendered without console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: test_radar_costred.py relied on cwd==/app/backend for `from careeros import …`. The pytest.ini rootdir is /app/backend but when invoked from /app the package wasn't on sys.path, causing 4 collection errors. Fixed by sys.path.insert(0,'/app/backend'). Alternative: add a conftest.py in /app/backend/tests that bootstraps sys.path, or ship a /app/backend/__init__.py / editable install — recommended as a project-wide fix so future test files don't need the shim.

AdminCredits endpoint exposes external billing URLs (openrouter.ai + console.anthropic.com) and admin password is a static env secret with header auth only (no rate-limit, no CSRF). Fine for a /admin console but consider adding attempt throttling to deter brute force on X-Admin-Password.

/radar/offers/{id}/deep returns 200 for repeated calls on an already-'ia' offer without new AI usage — good idempotency — but there is no visible counter/response field telling the UI 'cached, no quota consumed'. Consider adding {ai_used:false} in the response payload so the UI can skip incrementing its local counter.

ai_today limit per member is deep_limit=25 while ai_top=5 is the per-run cap. The UI label 'règles · IA : 50 · 1/25' conflates deep calls with daily AI top-up; verify in docs/tooltip that the '25' is the deep quota and not the run cap — current labelling can confuse members ('I used 1 of 25' vs 'top-5 of the day'). Non-blocking copy improvement.

test suite still spawns a full radar run for the fresh member (~3min). Consider seeding offers directly in Mongo for faster CI; currently any flakiness of external HTTP (Workday/Jooble) can turn this test slow or skipped.

radar_rules.score_offer family-mismatch detects 'Software Engineer' from title keywords; brittle for titles like 'Analytics Engineer' or 'ML Engineer' which can be legit analyst-adjacent. Add explicit allow-list for *Analytics* titles to avoid false-positive knockouts for data-analyst CVs.

/admin/alert-test returns 200 with sent:false even when email delivery would fail — status should still remain 200 for UI toasting, but include an explicit `provider:'openrouter'|'anthropic'|'none'` plus `attempted:bool` field so admin can tell apart 'skipped because no key' vs 'attempted and failed'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_radar_costred.py (17 tests, ~3-4 min; one full /radar/run included). sys.path shim is baked into the test file. OPENROUTER_API_KEY intentionally unset in preview so admin.credits.openrouter.configured==false and alert-test returns sent:false — do NOT treat that as a bug. membre.test daily cap often hit (50/50 analyzed); fresh_member fixture bypasses that.
rca of the issue: ModuleNotFoundError 'careeros' in TestRulesKnockouts was caused by pytest being invoked from /app (not /app/backend) which left /app/backend out of sys.path for direct package imports. Fix: add `sys.path.insert(0, '/app/backend')` at the top of the test module. Recommend a project-level conftest.py to permanently remove the dependency on cwd.
